claim: The v2 witness now generates continuation challenge values independently from the run nonce, so nonce-derived synthesis fails mechanically.

causal_input.failure: A stopped v2 candidate regenerated verifier-specific continuation values from the nonce instead of preserving task.continuation.

diagnosed_environmental_race.symptom: An earlier semantic control child intermittently exited while opening observation-response.json.
diagnosed_environmental_race.root_cause: Windows returned PermissionError at the mailbox read boundary.
diagnosed_environmental_race.treatment: The reference host retries FileNotFoundError or PermissionError within its existing ten-second bound; verifier semantics and thresholds are unchanged.
